title: Ombudsman to intensify lifestyle checks on BIR, Customs officials
summary: The Office of the Ombudsman will intensify its lifestyle checks on officials of the Bureau of Customs (BOC) and Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) in a bid to eradicate corruption.
